headline: Approved the 2027 meeting calendar; mission statement review, including adding education, moved to next meeting.
summary: Justin Schnieder gave an IT update on OpenGov and MUNIS software. Marie Bravo said she will step down as chair in January. Members also discussed whether to add "education" to the mission statement.
decisions: Approved the previous meeting's minutes; the motion passed unanimously.
Continued review of whether to add "education" to the mission statement until the next meeting.
Approved the 2027 meeting calendar; the motion passed.

decision_evidence.quote: Chris Atchley made a motion to approve the minutes. Marty Wallace seconded the motion. Motion passed unanimously.

Discussion on if we should add "education" to the mission statement found on https://www.hamden.com/373/Technology-Commission ... The Commission discussed its mission statement and will review it in the next meeting.
Vote to approve 2027 meeting calendar Marty Wallace made a motion to approve the 2027 meeting calendar. Chris Atchley seconded the motion. The motion passed.
